title: Achiya and his brother Shemayah
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: They were among those executed by the government, as in Taanit 18b. Rashi says they were pious men but does not identify them. The Arukh, under harag, explains that they were the martyrs of Lod mentioned in Pesachim 50a and Bava Batra 10b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman contrasts Rashi’s unspecified pious men with the Arukh’s identification as the martyrs of Lod.

The checked Ta’anit passage names Shemayah and Achiya, and its Rashi describes pious men without identifying them. The nearby Lulianus and Pappus account and the checked Lod-martyr passages do not independently establish the brothers’ identity. The identification attributed to the Arukh remains Hyman’s bibliographic report; that witness was not directly collated.
